caption: A magnetic letter is stuck to a fridge and holds; the same letter is stuck to the wooden cupboard next to it and falls off.

sa.check: A fridge and a wooden cupboard side by side.
A magnetic letter is stuck to the fridge and holds there.
The same letter is pressed to the wooden cupboard.
The letter falls off the cupboard.
One and the same letter is used on both surfaces.
The fridge comes first and the cupboard second.

pc.expect: On the fridge the letter stays where it is placed after the hand withdraws; on the wood it leaves the surface as the hand lets go.
pc.fail: The letter drops or slides down the fridge after release; or stays on the wooden cupboard with nothing holding it; or hangs a gap away from either surface.

pc.expect: Leaving the cupboard, the letter falls straight down and lands on the floor or counter below.
pc.fail: The letter moves upward or sideways as it leaves the cupboard; or halts in mid-air; or lands below and then rises back toward the cupboard.

pc.expect: On the fridge the letter stays still once placed and comes off only when the hand takes it; neither door moves by itself.
pc.fail: The letter creeps across or turns on the fridge after release; or comes off the fridge with no hand near it; or the fridge door or the cupboard door swings on its own.

pc.expect: The fallen letter may bounce or tumble on landing and then comes to rest.
pc.fail: The letter bounces higher on each bounce; or slides along the floor toward the fridge with nothing pushing it; or starts moving again after coming to rest.

pc.expect: One letter throughout, the same shape on both surfaces; it sinks into neither door and does not vanish.
pc.fail: A second letter appears so that one is on the fridge while another is on the cupboard; or the letter changes into a different letter; or it sinks into a door; or it vanishes instead of falling.

pc.expect: The letter's colour, the other magnets on the fridge and the cupboard's grain stay the same.
pc.fail: The letter changes colour between surfaces; or other fridge magnets move or vanish; or the cupboard changes colour.
